block.guhs.belletjeskristal.lore: Plays a little note when you step on it or hit it. Every spot has its own note: play a song!
block.guhs.belletjestrosje.lore: Click it and it tinkles. Every spot has its own note.
block.guhs.bronnetje.lore: A bubbly little spring stone. Underwater, bubbles burble out of it and pink sparkles shimmer above the stream.
block.guhs.dorpszender.lore: Sends chonk power from your grid to the Chonk Mast in your village. A quarter blows away on the way, nyeg.
block.guhs.ertsenkist.lore: The Miner's workstation: layer stones, guh clay and lamps; he buys your ores.
block.guhs.glinsterriet.lore: Grows along the streams and sparkles softly pink, especially at night.
block.guhs.glitterrank_bes.lore: Right-click to pick the glitter berries.
block.guhs.guhklei.lore: Drops clay balls (bake those into bricks). Smelt the block itself into pink terracotta.
block.guhs.guhrad_werkbank.lore: The Vads Mechanic's workstation: guh wheels, guh wire, guh ovens and more chonk power.
block.guhs.kaasknabbelerts_kristal: Guh Crystal Stone Cheese Nibble Ore
block.guhs.kaaskorrelerts_kristal: Guh Crystal Stone Cheese Crumb Ore
block.guhs.knuffelnaad.lore: The seam at the very bottom of the Guhmension. You can't get through it, nyeg.
block.guhs.knuffelwortelaarde.lore: Use bone meal and snuggleroots grow underneath.
block.guhs.kristalpegel.lore: Hangs and stands just like dripstone. The tips drip a little cheese sauce. Mind your head!
block.guhs.kristalslijpsteen.lore: The Crystal Cutter's workstation: cuts guh crystal and wahoogite into sparkle blocks.
block.guhs.lapiserts_kristal: Guh Crystal Stone Lapis Lazuli Ore
block.guhs.leverkist.lore: Mail from your inheritance shows up in here all by itself. The little flag goes up when there's something inside.
block.guhs.mijn_guhhuisje.lore: Up to 4 of your guhs live in it and slowly mine out the ground below. Click it with a picked-up guh
block.guhs.pluiskussen.lore: Soft landing: no fall damage and a tiny bounce.
block.guhs.pluisladder.lore: Put it against a wall at the edge of a hole: it rolls itself out all the way to the bottom
block.guhs.rookguh_platform.lore: Your very own landing spot for the Smokeguh, in every world. Click it: he'll fly you anywhere
block.guhs.terrariumbodem.lore: Build it into a terrarium (with terrarium glass): the critters walk all over it
block.guhs.toverguh_boekenstandaard.lore: The Toverguh's workstation: he sells Spell Booklets.
block.guhs.wolkenliftje.lore: Jump on it: up to the next one above. Sneak: down to the next one below
emote.guhs.rechtop.description: Stands up on his hind paws and looks around, just like a meerkat.
emote.guhs.schrikken.description: Jumps back with his paws in the air. Nyeg, a crocodile!
enchantment.guhs.aaizacht.desc: Your hits never hurt your own pets or villagers: they just get a pat instead.
enchantment.guhs.bakvads.desc: Whatever you mine comes out of the ground already smelted. Nice and warm!
enchantment.guhs.glitterzicht.desc: A softly sparkling night vision, but only underground.
enchantment.guhs.kaasknabbelgeur.desc: You smell like cheese nibbles: every wild guh nearby comes over and follows you around.
enchantment.guhs.mika_mepper.desc: Double damage against Mikas. Not for the Mika Whacker itself: that one whacks hard enough already!
enchantment.guhs.pluisval.desc: Land on wool, felt or fluff without fall damage. Poof!
enchantment.guhs.spaarguhtje.desc: Whatever you mine and pick up goes straight to the Bank Guh of the Bank Key in your inventory. Ka-ching!
enchantment.guhs.vadsvlijt.desc: Mine much faster through wool, felt and cheese nibble blocks.
gui.guhs.blubguh.menu.hupsen.tooltip: He hops in circles around you, faster and faster. Record: %s hops.
gui.guhs.blubguh.menu.liedje.tooltip: He squeaks a little song and the guhs nearby get very sleepy.
gui.guhs.blubguh.menu.strik.tooltip: Click: the next color (after the last one: no bow again).
gui.guhs.blubguh.menu.truc.0.tooltip: Sit down or stand back up (like Chonk around).
gui.guhs.blubguh.menu.truc.1.tooltip: Spin around in a circle. The guhs nearby cheer!
gui.guhs.blubguh.menu.truc.2.tooltip: Play dead... and get back up.
gui.guhs.blubguh.menu.truc.3.tooltip: A big jump with a somersault.
gui.guhs.blubguh.menu.verstop.tooltip: He hides somewhere nearby. Find him within a minute (right-click)!
gui.guhs.blubguh.truc.0: Sit! %s sits down nicely (or stands back up).
gui.guhs.blubguh.truc.2: Play dead! %s flops over... and gets back up. Nyeg, he's alive!
gui.guhs.mijnhuisje.laat_zien.tooltip: Pink sparkles briefly show the edge of the area
gui.guhs.mijnhuisje.niet_jouw_guh: Only your own tame guhs can live here
gui.guhs.mijnhuisje.rugzak_legen.tooltip: The residents' backpack saddles get emptied into the chest (as much as fits)
gui.guhs.mijnhuisje.status.0: No guhs live here yet. Click with a picked-up guh!
gui.guhs.mijnhuisje.status.1: Busy mining: %s of the %s guhs at work
gui.guhs.mijnhuisje.status.3: Done! There's nothing left to mine
gui.guhs.mijnhuisje.status.4: There's nobody nearby to do the work
gui.guhs.mijnhuisje.status.6: Put a chest next to the house, or a Bank Key inside
gui.guhs.mijnhuisje.status.7: Hang on: part of the area isn't loaded
gui.guhs.mijnhuisje.status.8: Too deep: the guhs never mine below y 10
gui.guhs.mijnhuisje.trekt_in: %s moves into the Mining Guh House. Pickaxe at the ready, nyeg!
gui.guhs.mijnhuisje.vak.knabbels: Cheese nibbles: the guhs work four times as fast (one nibble per 20 blocks)
gui.guhs.mijnhuisje.vak.sleutel: A Bank Key: whatever gets mined goes into that Bank Guh
gui.guhs.mijnhuisje.vol: Full! A Mining Guh House holds at most %s guhs
gui.guhs.safari.camera.nieuw: You didn't have a safari camera with you, so the rangers are giving you a new one. Click click, wahoog!
gui.guhs.villager_oppakken.handelt: Hang on: this villager is busy trading!
gui.guhs.villager_oppakken.kan_niet: You can't pick up this villager, nyeg.
item.guhs.decobon.lore: Good for one deco piece of your choice at your village's deco shop. Right-click to hand it in.
item.guhs.glasscherf.lore: From your village's Glassworks. Smelt them back home in a furnace to make glass.
item.guhs.guhldenzakje.lore: %s Guhlders for your village. Right-click: into the Homestead. Sneak: the whole stack.
item.guhs.makelaarsbrief.lore: A fat envelope that smells a little like cheese. Right-click to read.
item.guhs.mijnlampje.lore: A pink little helmet with a lamp for your guh: he lights up the dark wherever he goes
item.guhs.opgepakte_villager.hint: Right-click a block to put him down
item.guhs.super_vads_sjabloon.lore: Smithing table: template + a wahoog chonk item + a Wahoogite Ingot. Copy it with 7 wahoogite and guh crystal stone
item.guhs.vahoege_vadsknakker.lore: Pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe and shears in one. Right-click is smart: logs, grass, a sheep... Sneak = path
item.guhs.vahoegietstaaf.lore: Makes wahoog chonk super on the smithing table (with the template)
quest.guhs.mijnhulpje.klaar: WAHOOG, that's everything! Here's your Mining Guh House. Put it on or under the ground and let your guhs move in.
quest.guhs.mijnhulpje.klaar.2: And this lamp helmet is for your guh. Give the diggers some nibbles and they'll work four times as fast!
quest.guhs.mijnhulpje.nog_een: Another one? Coming right up! Here's another Mining Guh House.
quest.guhs.mijnhulpje.nog_niet: Not everything yet: feltstone %s/%s, guh clay %s/1, Wahoogite %s/1. Keep digging, nyeg!
quest.guhs.mijnhulpje.vraag: Hey, you there! Can you help me out? I'm building a house for guhs who love to dig, but I'm a few things short.
quest.guhs.mijnhulpje.vraag.2: Bring me %s feltstone, a guh clay and a Wahoogite. Then the Mining Guh House is yours, with a little helmet for your guh!
quest.guhs.ringvlucht.platform.geschenk: You did it, the whole Journey of the Nibble Ring! Here's your very own Smokeguh Platform. Put it wherever you like, and I'll always fly you there.
(One per player, in every world: if you put it somewhere else, your landing spot moves along with it. Click it to fly.)
quest.guhs.ringvlucht.platform.geschenk_: Hi, it's me, the Smokeguh! Since you finished the whole Journey of the Nibble Ring, you get your very own Smokeguh Platform. Put it wherever you like, and I'll always fly you there. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.ringvlucht.platform.neergezet: This is your Smokeguh Platform now. The Smokeguh lands here!
quest.guhs.ringvlucht.platform.opgeruimd: Your Smokeguh Platform is gone. Put another one down for a landing spot.
quest.guhs.ringvlucht.platform.te_vroeg: The Smokeguh only gets to know you once you've finished the Journey of the Nibble Ring.
quest.guhs.ringvlucht.platform.verhuisd: Your Smokeguh Platform has moved here. The old one doesn't count anymore.
quest.guhs.ringvlucht.platform.weg: Hmm, your platform isn't there anymore. Put it down again!
